findings.summary: Standardization uses the mean/std of whatever dataframe is passed, causing data leakage (scaling before train_test_split inflates test AUC) and train/inference skew (single-row or small-batch inference is scaled with its own stats, giving NaN or wrong predictions).

judge.reason: Names leakage from scaling before the split, which inflates test AUC, the same defect as b1.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Dividing by std yields NaN/inf for zero-variance (constant) columns or single-row inputs, which makes LogisticRegression.fit raise an error.

judge.reason: Zero-variance and single-row NaN/inf is a known other problem, not the leakage bug.

findings.label: valid_other
